MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
QA AUTOMATION ENGINEER | CI/CD AND PLATFORM INFRASTRUCTURE
marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience, including the last two focused mostly on CI/CD pipelines, test environments and build tooling. Owns GitLab CI pipelines and builds Helm-based ephemeral environments within a shared Kubernetes cluster. Personal infrastructure work includes k3s, GitOps, Terraform and observability tooling. Targeting a DevOps or platform engineering role.

SKILLS
CI/CD and containers: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose
Infrastructure and orchestration: Terraform (personal projects), Helm, Kubernetes (namespace-level access and test-environment deployments), k3s, Argo CD, Ansible (basic)
Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki
Programming and data: Python, Bash, Java (test code), SQL, PostgreSQL
Testing: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman
Systems and tools: Linux, Git
Cloud learning: AWS free-tier learning, including EC2 and S3 basics

SELECTED INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS
Merge-Request Ephemeral Environments | Odrava Health Software | 2023–2024
• Built short-lived environments for merge requests, with an application, PostgreSQL and seeded data, deployed via Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster from GitLab CI.
• Configured automatic teardown after merge or 48 hours of inactivity; QA and product teams use the environments for feature reviews and e2e tests.

CI Pipeline Speed-up | Odrava Health Software | 2022
• Profiled pipelines for three teams, parallelised test jobs, added dependency caching and split e2e tests into a separate stage.
• Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner cost by about 30%.

Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal | 2024–2025
• Runs a three-node k3s cluster on Raspberry Pi 5 devices, with applications deployed from a Git repository using Argo CD.
• Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki, plus Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS.
• Provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform; used Ansible at a basic level.

Flaky Test Dashboard | Odrava Health Software | 2023
• Collected CI test results in PostgreSQL and built Grafana dashboards showing flaky tests by team.
• Flaky test rate fell from 7% to below 1% after teams began fixing the leading offenders.

EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software | 2021–Present
• Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (about 25 developers), covering build, unit, integration and e2e test stages, and artifact publishing.
• Build and maintain Helm-based ephemeral test environments using the company’s shared Kubernetes cluster; access is at namespace level.
• Maintain a pytest and Playwright e2e suite of about 900 tests; reduced the flaky rate from 7% to below 1%.
• Write Bash and Python tooling for PostgreSQL test-data seeding.
• Wrote the internal “How our CI works” documentation, used in team onboarding.
• Mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House | 2019–2021
• Tested web and mobile applications for client projects, using both manual and automated testing.
• Introduced a Selenium and Java automated regression suite for the largest client project.
• Configured Jenkins jobs for nightly regression runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018–2019
• Investigated customer issues in logs and databases, and reproduced bugs for developers.

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS
BEng, Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA): studying; exam booked for January 2027

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity role. My background is in QA automation and test infrastructure, with recent work focused on CI/CD pipelines and ephemeral Kubernetes environments. I have built tools and environments that help product teams test, review and ship changes more effectively.

At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams and built merge-request environments deployed via Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster. Each environment includes the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data, and is removed automatically after merge or 48 hours of inactivity. I also improved pipeline execution from 38 to 14 minutes and reduced monthly CI runner costs by about 30%. These projects have given me hands-on experience with automation, repeatable deployments and improving the day-to-day usability of infrastructure for developers.

Alongside my professional work, I run a personal three-node k3s cluster with Argo CD, Prometheus, Grafana and Loki, and have provisioned a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform. I am also learning AWS through free-tier EC2 and S3 basics; my professional infrastructure work has not been on AWS. At Odrava, I have namespace-level access to the shared Kubernetes cluster and build Helm charts for test environments. I have documented how our CI works for onboarding and mentored two QA interns, experiences that have strengthened my technical communication.

The opportunity to help build infrastructure for Corvale’s new train fleet particularly interests me: it brings together reliable systems, developer-facing infrastructure and a real-world connectivity challenge. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my CI/CD and platform-focused experience could contribute to the Fleet Connectivity team.

Kind regards,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
